test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd88a09c52e80a5aff71f8d8617a57ead14a299e25dff0b23225856058c3a5f8.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: Letter 'N' has shifting a place in clockwise direction in next images, and replaced with H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6099f8047b5572a11bcad19f8fa7fa8aa9817b2c73c857d1e6b8447d3464a8a.png] 

Step II: Letter 'K' has shifting a place in clockwise direction in next images, and replaced with G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6616bbb9780cb3856bb1dade649d2a6767b4fb15dd86a848bad6049dc5ef1b55.png] 

Step III: Letter 'R' has shifting a place in clockwise direction in next images, and replaced with S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9838100e319f056c68f06c046256bf5f26234d628f04ba0549a1e41198e9e9a.png] 

Step IV: Letter 'P' has shifting a place in clockwise direction in next images, and replaced with T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28fcaedf91426153be1e5fd4b80152697f0b260c92e68f4bdddf5d1a0a9b90ff.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2141500fb24f6b33367aa4eae7ae9a3d3f103b907c411c1cf6a2a0bb108da3d.png] 

So, 'Option 4' will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
